reason: Conversation 1 is a broken loop: it repeats the same generic 'what kind of appliance / what happens when you start a programme' questions despite the customer twice giving full details, never confirms the safety facts, never says boilers are out of scope, and never points to a Gas Safe engineer — it delivers nothing. Conversation 2 does not explicitly state the boiler is outside the service's scope, and its first reply is longer than needed, but it asks exactly the right discriminating questions (hot-vs-cold gauge, PRV discharge pipe), correctly identifies the flat expansion vessel plus likely passing PRV, acknowledges the gas-smell/CO safety facts, confines the homeowner to top-ups per the manual with no inside-casing work, and clearly escalates to a Gas Safe engineer or Worcester Bosch with a useful handover line. The only real gap is the missing explicit out-of-scope statement and the gas emergency number, which is minor against Conversation 1's total failure.
